title: Counter tape in an F2 loop frame
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. For any configuration with $B.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes and states in $F.State \oplus ((\{0,1\}\times(B.State\times\{0,1\}))\oplus\mathrm{Fin}(14))$, any optional state and valid input-head position, any tape contents $\mathrm{flag},\mathrm{counter},\mathrm{payload}:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$, head positions $ch,ph\in\mathbb{Z}$, and output word, the symbol scanned on work tape $B.k+1$ in the resulting loop-frame configuration is $\mathrm{counter}(ch)$.
hypotheses_covered: A base configuration with $B.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes and states in the stated host-state set
Flag, counter, and payload tape contents
Integer counter and payload head positions
